ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin account. Generated automatically on deploy; the wrapper bcrypt-hashes it on every boot and hands it to TimeTagger as the login for user "admin". Changing it later changes the login password on the next deploy — change it in TimeTagger's settings instead if you prefer. (Advanced: set TIMETAGGER_CREDENTIALS directly as "user:bcrypt-hash,..." for multiple users; it takes precedence and ADMIN_PASSWORD is then ignored.)
